stages.label: Request received
stages.customerText: We have your request and will confirm your appointment.

stages.label: Inspection scheduled
stages.customerText: Your inspection is on the calendar.

stages.label: Inspection complete
stages.customerText: We have inspected your roof. Photos and notes are on the way.

stages.label: Estimate delivered
stages.customerText: Your options and pricing are ready to review.

stages.label: Agreement signed
stages.customerText: Thanks. We are preparing your project.

announcementTemplates.title: Storm watch: priority inspections open
announcementTemplates.body: Severe weather is in the forecast. Book a storm damage assessment and we will prioritize open slots as conditions allow.

announcementTemplates.title: After the storm: schedule your assessment
announcementTemplates.body: If you saw hail, wind damage or leaks, book an assessment. Take photos and note the date of the storm.

announcementTemplates.title: Weather delays possible this week
announcementTemplates.body: Rain may shift install dates. Your dashboard will show updates if your schedule changes.

announcementTemplates.title: Holiday scheduling
announcementTemplates.body: Online booking is closed on the dates shown. You can still book any open day.

announcementTemplates.title: Hurricane season prep
announcementTemplates.body: The Atlantic hurricane season runs June 1 to November 30. A pre-season inspection can catch loose flashing, lifted shingles and clogged drainage.
